title: A Change theme button in the website editor opens every theme and its starter kits

source.ref: Mega Theme plan, the editor's Change theme button (ADR-1890)

detail: The Theme tab opens with a Change theme row that names the current theme and opens a dialog of every theme plus the kits of the theme now worn. The tab and the dialog share one pick handler, so a switch is one undo step and saves the site style.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; vitest on the editor shell passes.
